//: Release notes are built from COMMIT SUBJECTS by git-action-release-changelog-builder. The default commit_template is '- #{{TITLE}}', so only the subject line is used -- this repo's commit bodies run 40-70 lines and none of that reaches the notes. Categories match the Conventional Commits prefixes this repo already uses, so grouping is free. #{{UNCATEGORIZED}} is present deliberately: without it, entries matching no rule are DROPPED rather than listed, which would silently lose commits from a release.
empty_template: - No changes recorded between these tags.
